description: Search the USGS Mineral Resources Data System for mines, prospects and mineral occurrences by bounding box, site name or commodity. AUTHORITATIVE for "what has been mined near here" and "where are the US lithium/copper/gold occurrences" — returns each site's deposit id, name, development status (Producer, Past Producer, Prospect, Occurrence), coordinates and commodity codes. Sourced from USGS MRData.

commodity.description: Commodity symbol as MRDS codes it, e.g. "AU" (gold), "CU" (copper), "LI" (lithium), "REE". List them with mrdata_commodities.

name_contains.description: Site-name substring, case-sensitive as stored, e.g. "Bingham", "Rico"

name: mrdata_search_deposits
title: Mrdata Search Deposits
